data.one_liner: Add and manage HTML document meta tags for search engine optimization in Flutter web apps.
data.what_it_does: Meta SEO is a package for adding metadata to HTML documents in the head tag to improve search engine optimization for Flutter web applications. It supports standard meta tags, Open Graph tags, and Twitter Card tags.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application that needs search engine optimization (SEO).
You need to dynamically update page titles, descriptions, keywords, Open Graph tags, or Twitter Cards.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile-only or desktop-only application that does not target the web.
strengths: Easy integration with Flutter web apps and routers like GoRouter.
Supports Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags for better social sharing.
Automatically deletes duplicated meta tags and keeps the latest in order.
weaknesses: Platform-dependent functionality primarily limited to the web platform.
Requires live server environment for certain meta tags like Open Graph to be tested properly.
data.setup_notes: Call MetaSEO().config() in the main function before running the app inside a kIsWeb check.
